decisive_spans.text: Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present

response.rationale: The vignette describes malignant squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, and mitotic figures, which directly supports Squamous cell carcinoma (D6). This also contradicts Keratoacanthoma (D7) and Basal cell carcinoma (D2). The proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells pushing into the dermis further supports D6 and contradicts D2 and D4.
